required_for_actual_execution: Bound input identities and scientific context

forbidden_promotions: A static inspection cannot become a runtime result
A computed graph syntax check cannot become causal discovery
A project formula cannot become an engine estimate
A live numerical call with generated input cannot become bank data validation
A mock or replay cannot become an external owner run
A completed response with disposition unsupported/refused cannot become a returned estimate

local: Resolve full engine environments before third-party adapter admission

Record modern MCP/HTTP separately if implemented
Benchmark actual consumers with fixed protocol and complete cost denominator
external_conditional: Owner-run consumer conformance and actual custody/configuration
Independent scientific review of consequential assumptions
Bank assignment/measurement/transport validation only after prototype merit supports the expense

limitations: Transport trial retains sandbox anyio limitation; no new MCP run
